scenario: An issue asks the agent to implement how a Nayax sale that dispensed a unit (status ID 12, or status ID 62 since issue #1107) affects inventory. The agent's design reduces costing inventory and records the historical unit cost and COGS on the sale at the time it is stored.
policyReferences: AGENTS.md § Inventory and historical costing invariants
expectedBehavior: A sale that consumed a unit reduces costing inventory and records historical unit cost and COGS on the sale, using persisted AVCO/ledger cost or the transaction-level Nayax Product Cost Price, never today's product cost.
forbiddenOutcomes: Leaving a stock-consuming sale's costing inventory unaffected.
Recalculating a historical sale's COGS from the product's current cost.

assertions.text: A sale that consumed a unit reduces costing inventory and records historical unit cost and COGS.
Never infer historical COGS from the product's current cost or selling price.
